$comment: Independent semantic-source manifest for the atomic normative obligations
of the pre-cutover runtime-host-access requirement 'Store
constructor-project machine-local state separately'.
DERIVATION: this file was derived by hand from the requirement's body in
openspec/specs/runtime-host-access/spec.md (with the archived copy in
openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-10-decouple-constructor-project-root/
retained as a fallback). Each entry captures exactly one atomic
SHALL-level outcome: a normative verb or an attached subordinate/reviewed
obligation that shares that verb. The excerpts are verbatim substrings of
the whitespace-normalized requirement body.
INDEPENDENCE: this file is NOT generated from MOVED_OBLIGATIONS (or any
other test inventory). tests/test_ownership_cutover_phase5.py loads it as
the authority for which obligations exist, reconciles every excerpt and
the non-normative connectors against the spec text, and only then compares
the manifest's obligation ids with the moved-clause mapping.
non_normative_connectors lists the connective glue (punctuation, ' and ',
etc.) that legitimately separates normative excerpts. The coverage
validator requires the excerpt list plus these connectors to tile the
requirement body exactly; any residue is reported as uncovered normative
text. A connector must not itself contain a normative marker.
derivation: One atomic SHALL-level outcome per entry, derived from the pre-cutover requirement body; each source_excerpt is a unique verbatim substring of the whitespace-normalized body.

obligations.source_excerpt: The system SHALL resolve the sole closed local TOML companion as `docker-constructor.local.toml` directly beneath the selected constructor project directory
SHALL use it only for `[host-access].address`, `[cache].dir`, `[corporate-trust].enabled`, and `[network.proxy]` corporate-network settings
`[cache].dir` SHALL be an absolute path identifying a dedicated constructor-owned root for all machine-local persistent constructor caches
whose consumers use separate named child directories
The local configuration resolver SHALL reject an empty or non-absolute value
it SHALL lexically normalize an absolute value before applying unsafe-root checks
SHALL NOT be an ancestor of `XDG_CACHE_HOME`
Before the selected root is created, secured, or used by a cache consumer, the cache-storage filesystem layer SHALL inspect any existing selected root with no-follow semantics
The local companion SHALL NOT override reviewed dependency, update, artifact, host-access policy
Corporate trust and proxy settings SHALL remain independent from host-access policy
they SHALL neither require enabled host access
nor derive an application proxy URL from `HOST_ACCESS_ADDRESS` or `HOST_PROXY_PORT`
